description: MEDIA-ILL-01: Wikimedia Commons files selected by visual review (Claude, Project Director) from ChatGPT research HY-02b (docs/research/media/HY02B_SOURCES.md). Ingest with tools/media/loc_ingest.py, which re-reads the licence template from the file wikitext and refuses anything but public-domain/CC0 templates; downloads via Special:FilePath thumbnails (thumb.php) at the given width.

selections.subject: chemical_fertilizers
selections.author: Henry de Witt Moulton
selections.name: Phân bón hóa học
selections.description: Loading cars with guano at the Great Heap, Chincha Islands, Peru; albumen print by Henry de Witt Moulton, c. 1865 (Bibliothèque nationale de France)
selections.review_note: Guano extraction, the main imported fertilizer before superphosphates; labelled as guano mining, not fertilizer manufacture (HY-02b candidate 1A).

selections.subject: dw_statuto_albertino
selections.author: Unknown artist
selections.name: Statuto Albertino
selections.description: Charles Albert of Sardinia signs the Statuto, 1848; 19th-century woven picture (Turin Risorgimento collections)
selections.review_note: Scene of the signing; decorative border trimmed (HY-02b 5A). Undated, second half of the 19th century: year set conservatively to 1900.

selections.subject: dw_prussian_constitution
selections.author: A. Klaus
selections.name: Hiến pháp Phổ
selections.description: Barricade fighting at Alexanderplatz, Berlin, night of 18-19 March 1848; lithograph by A. Klaus, 1848
selections.review_note: The March revolution in Berlin that forced the Prussian constitution of 1848 (HY-02b 4B). 1848 lithograph: PD-Art, artist dead long before 1955.

selections.subject: dw_corn_laws
selections.author: Unknown artist
selections.name: Bãi bỏ Corn Laws
selections.description: Meeting of the Anti-Corn Law League at Exeter Hall, London, 1846; contemporary wood engraving
selections.review_note: Low-resolution scan shown whole on a blurred field (HY-02b 2B); replace if the Heidelberg Punch master (2A) becomes available.

selections.subject: dw_french_abolition
selections.author: Provisional Government of the French Republic; annotated by Victor Schœlcher
selections.name: Bãi bỏ chế độ nô lệ tại Pháp
selections.description: Draft of the decree abolishing slavery in the French colonies, annotated by Victor Schœlcher, 1848 (Archives nationales d'outre-mer): "Article 1er. L'esclavage sera entièrement aboli"
selections.review_note: Primary document, shown whole (HY-02b 3A). Biard painting rejected: only a 283 px reproduction.

selections.subject: dw_belgium_recognition
selections.author: Paulus Lauters
selections.name: Công nhận độc lập Bỉ
selections.description: Entrance to the Park at the Place Royale, Brussels, 27 September 1830, during the Belgian Revolution; lithograph by Paulus Lauters, 1830-1831
selections.review_note: Belgian independence era scene (HY-02c 1A, Rijksmuseum CC0); not captioned as the 1839 treaty signing.

selections.subject: zollverein_accessions
selections.author: Johann Valerius Kutscheit
selections.credit: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Cartes et plans, GE D-11028 (BIS), Gallica btv1b8469035q
selections.name: Mở rộng Zollverein
selections.description: Customs and railway map of the German Zollverein states, J. V. Kutscheit, Berlin 1846, with a table of accession dates
selections.review_note: Contemporary 1846 map of the customs union (HY-02c 2A); shown whole so state borders and the accession table stay legible. PD-France + PD-US-expired; attribution kept.

selections.subject: sewing_machine_maker
selections.author: Anonymous
selections.name: Hãng máy may
selections.description: The Singer sewing-machine factory at Wittenberge, Province of Brandenburg; anonymous colour print, after 1904
selections.review_note: Bird's-eye view of a real pre-1914 sewing-machine works (HY-03, MSG-072); printed title trimmed. Factory opened 1904: year set to 1910.

selections.subject: harvester_manufacturer
selections.author: Unknown (postcard)
selections.credit: Newberry Library, Chicago (NBY 417737), via Wikimedia Commons
selections.name: Hãng máy gặt đập
selections.description: Deering Harvester Works on the North Branch of the Chicago River; tinted postcard, early 20th century
selections.review_note: Real harvester factory (HY-03, MSG-072); 828 px source shown whole; title band trimmed. PD-1923 template: year set to 1922.

selections.subject: agricultural_machine_maker
selections.author: Unknown engraver (newspaper advertisement)
selections.name: Hãng máy nông nghiệp
selections.description: A horse-drawn McCormick No. 4 mower-reaper at work; newspaper advertisement engraving, 4 July 1896
selections.review_note: The product of an agricultural machine maker (HY-03, MSG-072); advertising text cropped away.
